name: Hill Dwarf
desc: As a hill dwarf, you have keen senses, deep intuition, and remarkable resilience.
content: The Hill Dwarf is a subrace of the Dwarf race, known for their keen senses, deep intuition, and remarkable resilience. As a Hill Dwarf, you receive a +1 bonus to your Wisdom (WIS) ability score. One of your racial traits is Dwarven Toughness, enhancing your durability and endurance. This subrace does not have any starting proficiencies or additional languages.

name: Lightfoot Halfling
desc: As a lightfoot halfling, you can easily hide from notice, even using other people as cover. You're inclined to be affable and get along well with others. Lightfoots are more prone to wanderlust than other halflings, and often dwell alongside other races or take up a nomadic life.
content: The Lightfoot Halfling is a member of the Halfling race, known for their ability to easily hide from notice and their affable nature. They are more prone to wanderlust and often live alongside other races or lead a nomadic life. As a Lightfoot Halfling, you receive a +1 bonus to your Charisma score. One of your racial traits is Naturally Stealthy, allowing you to move unnoticed.

name: Rock Gnome
desc: As a rock gnome, you have a natural inventiveness and hardiness beyond that of other gnomes.
content: Rock Gnome is a subrace of the Gnome race, known for their inventiveness and hardiness. They receive a bonus to their Constitution (CON) ability score and are proficient with Tinker's Tools. Their racial traits include Artificer's Lore and Tinker.

name: High Elf
desc: As a high elf, you have a keen mind and a mastery of at least the basics of magic. In many fantasy gaming worlds, there are two kinds of high elves. One type is haughty and reclusive, believing themselves to be superior to non-elves and even other elves. The other type is more common and more friendly, and often encountered among humans and other races.
content: The High Elf is a member of the Elf race, known for their keen mind and proficiency in magic. They receive a bonus to their Intelligence ability score and starting proficiencies in Longswords, Shortswords, Shortbows, and Longbows. High Elves can choose one additional language from a variety of options. Their racial traits include Elf Weapon Training, High Elf Cantrip, and the ability to learn an extra language.
